title: Week Summary: Deployment Paradigms and System Requirements

concepts.name: Batch inference
concepts.description: Generating predictions for many records at scheduled times rather than immediately on demand.

concepts.name: Online inference
concepts.description: Generating predictions in response to live requests with user-facing latency constraints.

concepts.name: Streaming inference
concepts.description: Generating predictions over continuous event streams as data arrives.

concepts.name: Edge deployment
concepts.description: Running model inference on devices or infrastructure close to where data is produced or used.

concepts.name: Latency requirement
concepts.description: A constraint on how quickly a system must return a response.

concepts.name: Throughput requirement
concepts.description: A constraint on how many requests or records a system must process in a given time.

concepts.name: Availability requirement
concepts.description: A constraint on how reliably a system must remain accessible and operational.

concepts.name: Cost constraint
concepts.description: A limit on spending for compute, storage, network usage, development, or operations.
